description.narrative:
The overall objective of SI-COM II is to strengthen Iraqs migration governance and reintegration systems by enhancing capacities for sustainable reintegration, improving evidence-based migration management, and reinforcing border control systems.
The project is structured around four mutually reinforcing components:
Component 1 Operationalising and expanding MRC services: Strengthening Migrant Resource Centres (MRCs) in Sulaymaniyah and Erbil to provide standardised, inclusive and rights-based information, counselling, referral and reintegration-related support for returnees and potential migrants, including through SOP development, staff training, outreach and feedback/complaints mechanisms.
Component 2 Enhancing migration governance and labour mobility: Institutional capacity development for Iraqi authorities through tailored training, knowledge exchange and evidence-informed adaptive management, including continued work on project management (PM) and monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) tools and exploratory support linked to implementation of Iraqs national plan for safe, orderly and regular migration.
Component 3 Supporting digital transformation in the migration sector: Assessing and strengthening digital capabilities of relevant institutions, developing roadmaps and digital tools to support service delivery and coordination, and improving ethical and secure data governance and protection practices.
Component 4 Strengthening evidence-based border management through a National Coordination Centre: Supporting implementation of Iraqs National IBM Strategy by developing an operational framework and SOPs for a National Coordination Centre (NCC) to strengthen information exchange, situational awareness and inter-agency coordination, supported by capacity development and experience exchange.

Projektet syftar till att stärka Iraks migrationsstyrning, system för återintegrering och gränskontroll. Det omfattar fyra delar: att utveckla Migrationscenter, stärka myndigheters kapacitet inom migration och arbetskraftsrörlighet, stödja digitalisering inom migrationssektorn samt stärka evidensbaserad gränshantering genom ett nationellt samordningscenter.

The project aims to strengthen Iraq’s migration governance, reintegration systems and border control. It consists of four components: developing Migration Centres, enhancing the capacity of authorities in the areas of migration and labour mobility, supporting digitalisation within the migration sector, and strengthening evidence-based border management through a national coordination centre.
